seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Matchup Whitesides (D, incumbent) vs Gibbs (R) is supported by the LA Almanac (run-off in general), Wikipedia, and The Signal; not read directly from the SoS certified list. Election-night returns (The Signal) had Gibbs ahead 43.9% to 40.2%; final primary order not verified. Other primary candidates: Roberto Ramos (D), Caleb Norwood (D). Ballot designation lead only: a garbled search summary of the LA County June 2 primary candidate list showed Gibbs's occupation as City Councilmember/Engineer; his November designation is not confirmed. A search summary of the LA County general-election candidate list (content.lavote.gov, dated 9/2/2026) put Whitesides and Gibbs under the wrong district headings (31st or 42nd) with parties swapped; this looks like a PDF text-extraction error. Boundary conflict: one Signal snippet says the new district is mostly Ventura County with a sliver of western Santa Clarita Valley, while other coverage describes Santa Clarita, the Antelope Valley, and northern LA County. The Ventura description may refer to the new 26th District. Incumbent here means the current member for district number 27; Proposition 50 redrew the boundaries. Biographical coverage is thin because the shared web-search budget ran out before the per-candidate searches; education, birth year, and earlier career (for example, Whitesides's pre-Congress positions) were not researched.
